tagline: One room, one speaker, everyone's music: a shared queue that takes turns.
host_intro: Hosts sign in with Spotify; sessions play through their account or the player they connected. Joining a session needs no sign-in.
token_status_revoked: Revoked by Spotify: sign in again
auth_state_mismatch: The sign-in could not be verified. Please start it again.
auth_cancelled: The sign-in at Spotify was cancelled.
auth_not_allowlisted: Spotify refused this account. It has to be added to the allowlist of the Spotify app (User Management in the developer dashboard).
auth_failed: Spotify could not be reached. Please try again.
error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account_renew_hint: Spotify sign-ins are valid for 6 months. Sign in again before then to renew it.
account_player_intro: Optional: a second Spotify account (e.g. a free place in a family plan) that plays your sessions instead of your own account, so the music stays out of your listening history. It has to be signed in on the device at the speaker.
account_player_none: No player connected: your sessions play through your own account.
account_player_hint: Spotify asks which account to connect: choose “Not you?” and sign in with the player. It needs Premium and a place on the Spotify app's allowlist. Connecting it again renews its sign-in.
account_delete_hint: Deletes your stored Spotify tokens and your player's and signs you out everywhere. You can sign in again at any time.
auth_player_is_self: That is your own account. In Spotify's dialog, choose “Not you?” and sign in with the player.
auth_player_is_host: This account signs in to crowd-dj as a host itself, so it cannot be your player.
auth_is_player: This account is a host's player and does not sign in itself. In Spotify's dialog, choose “Not you?” and sign in with your own account.
auth_player_taken: This account is already another host's player.
renewal_expiring: The Spotify sign-in of {name} expires on {date}.
renewal_expired: The Spotify sign-in of {name} has expired: sessions cannot play through it.
renewal_hint_host: Sign in again to renew it for 6 months.
renewal_hint_player: Connect the player again to renew it for 6 months.
account_player_remove_hint: Your sessions play through your own account again. You can connect a player again at any time.
action_failed: That did not work. Please try again.
profile_intro: Your name shows in sessions next to the music you add. The profile is kept in this browser; no sign-in needed.
profile_name_invalid: Pick a name with 1 to {max} characters.
profile_too_many: Too many new profiles right now. Try again later, or open the personal link of a profile you already have.
profile_devices_intro: Open this link or scan the code on another device to use your profile there too. Anyone with the link can act as you, so keep it to yourself.
profile_link_question: Use the profile “{name}” on this device?
profile_link_replaces: This device uses the profile “{name}” so far. It will no longer be used here.
profile_link_current: This device already uses this profile.
profile_link_invalid: This profile link is not valid.
participant_intro: To join a session, open the link or scan the QR code the host shows. No sign-in needed.
session_start_expired: The Spotify sign-in of {name}, which plays your sessions, is no longer valid. Renew it on “My account” first.
session_not_found: This session does not exist. Check the link.
session_join_intro: Pick a name, so the others see who is here. It is kept in this browser for later sessions.
session_invite_intro: Scan the code or open the link to join. No sign-in needed.
session_mode_wishes_first_hint: Open wishes in turns per person; when none is open, a random track from the next person's pool.
session_mode_pool_only_hint: In turns per person, a random track from their pool.
session_mode_wishes_only_hint: In turns per person, in the order they wished.
session_anonymous_hint: Nobody sees who added a track, not even you; everyone sees their own. The participants stay visible.
session_skip_soon: Coming soon: skipping tracks. You can already choose how it will work in this session.
session_skip_own: Skip own tracks without a vote
session_skip_voting_hint: A track will be skipped once both are reached. You will always be able to skip right away.
session_settings_limit: Limits are whole numbers from 1 to 999, or empty.
session_settings_votes: The votes needed are a whole number from 1 to 999.
session_settings_percent: The share is a whole number from 1 to 100.
session_end_hint: Ends the session for everyone; the join link stops working. Pools are kept.
search_hint: Search, or paste links to tracks or an album. In the Spotify desktop app, select tracks (Ctrl+A for a whole playlist) and copy them (Ctrl+C).

match.countPlural=one: 1 more link was left out: at most {max} at a time.
match.countPlural=*: {count} more links were left out: at most {max} at a time.

catalog_too_many: Too many searches at once. Wait a minute and try again.
catalog_host_signin: The host has to sign in with Spotify again before anything can be searched.
catalog_host_refused: Spotify refused the host's account. It may no longer be on the allowlist of the Spotify app; tell the host.
catalog_busy: Spotify is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
catalog_failed: Spotify could not be reached. Please try again.
wishes_intro: Tracks you want to hear soon, in this session. They play in turns with the others.
wish_none: No wishes yet. Search for a track and wish it.
wish_mode_pool_only: Only pools play in this session; wishes are not taken.
wish_open_limit: You have as many open wishes as this session allows. Wait until one has played.
wish_session_limit: You have made as many wishes as this session allows.
wish_taken: This track has already been wished in this session.
pool_intro: Tracks you like. When it is your turn and you have no open wish, one of them plays at random. Your pool stays with your profile for later sessions.
pool_mode_wishes_only: Only wishes play in this session. Your pool stays with your profile for later sessions.

match.countPlural=one: In this session only your newest track counts.
match.countPlural=*: In this session only your {count} newest tracks count.

match.countPlural=one: Not counted in this session (only the newest counts)
match.countPlural=*: Not counted in this session (only the {count} newest count)

pool_empty: Your pool is empty. Search for tracks or paste links and add them.
profile_pool_intro: Kept for every session you join. Add tracks in a session.
wish_withdraw_played: This wish has been played already.
wish_played_already: This track has already played in this session.
playing_stopped: The music has not started yet.
playing_stopped_host: Start the music when the speaker is ready. Spotify has to be open on the device that plays.
playing_paused: Paused: something else was played on {account}.
playing_paused_host: Someone played something else on {account}, so no more tracks are handed to Spotify. Resume when the room is ready.
playing_waiting: Waiting for music: wish a track or add some to your pool.
playing_elsewhere: Spotify plays something of its own until the next track comes up.
playing_nothing: Nothing to play yet. It starts as soon as someone wishes a track or fills their pool.
playing_devices_intro: Devices where {account} is signed in to Spotify. A device that is missing: open Spotify on it, then look again.
playing_devices_none: No device found. Open Spotify on the device at the speaker, signed in as {account}.
playing_problem_no_device: No device is playing. Open Spotify on the device at the speaker, signed in as {account}, or pick a device.
playing_problem_refused: Spotify refused to control {account}. It needs Premium, a device that allows remote control, and a place on the Spotify app's allowlist.
playing_problem_signin: The Spotify sign-in of {account} is no longer valid. Renew it on “My account”.
playing_problem_busy: Spotify is busy. Trying again shortly.
playing_problem_failed: Spotify did not answer as expected. Trying again shortly.
next_may_change: May still change until shortly before the end of the current track.
session_leave_hint: Your turns end and your open wishes no longer play. Your pool stays with your profile. Open the join link to come back.
session_too_many: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
session_left_intro: Your pool is kept. Join again to take turns and have your wishes play.
session_rejoined: You are back in the session
